scope: Independent local publication audit of autonomous Agent v2 code/tests/docs and recorded evidence. No network, model calls, expensive Lean recompilation, production edits, or benchmark Test reads.
remote_responsibility: Root publisher must inspect current remote head/tree and verify immutable blobs before updating the branch. Prior publication manifests used here are historical local evidence only.

dependency_audit.limit: Static imports and registered dependency providers checked; external Lean/Mathlib toolchain is intentionally not bundled.

recorded_independent_audit.scope_limit: Recorded HTTP provenance and byte-exact response-to-proof continuity; no external provider attestation.

secret_scan.notes: Actual current API credentials were read only into memory. Public endpoints, provider request IDs and dummy fixture values are not secrets. This does not attest to secrets absent from unknown external sources.

limitations: No new model or Lean success is claimed by this publication audit.
Two autonomous preselected Train successes and one incomplete case remain attributed to revision 01; controlled expansion belongs to revision 02.
Four successful original receipts would not mean four distinct solved problems; controlled and independent checks repeat the first identity.
No all-Train success rate can be inferred.
Current remote branch and actual remote upload remain the responsibility of the root publisher; this agent only checked local archive and selection bytes.

publication_refresh.reason: Interrupted gzip upload replaced with deterministic xz archive and compressed member inventory. No original source or proof-evidence conclusion was changed.
publication_refresh.remote_base_attribution: Provided by root publisher; this agent did not query GitHub.
